scripts.name: SQL
scripts.script:
tw.local.sql
SELECT  REQUESTNO,  REQUESTNATURE, REQUESTTYPE, REQUESTDATE, REQUESTSTATE, REQUESTSTATUS, PARENTREQUESTNO,
FCCONTRACTNO, CONTRACTSTAGE, EXPORTPURPOSE, PAYMENTTERMS, PRODUCTCATEGORY, COMMODITYDESCRIPTION, --RI.ISLIQUIDATED,
RI.CIF, RI.CUSTOMERNAME, RI.BASEDATE, RI.VALUEDATE, RI.TENORDAYS, RI.TRANSITDAYS, RI.CONTRACTMATURITYDATE, 
RI.USERREF, RI.PRODUCTCODE, PRODUCTDESC, STAGE, SOURCEREF, TRADEFOREFNO, DISCOUNT, EXTRACHARGES, OURCHARGES,
AMOUNTSIGHT, AMOUNTDEFNOAVALIZATION, AMOUNTDEFAVALIZATION, COLLECTABLEAMOUNT, OUTSTANDINGAMOUNT, MATURITYDATE,
MATURITYDAYS, FINANCEAPPROVALNO, HUBCODE, HUBNAME, LIQAMOUNT, LIQCURRENCY, COLLECTIONCURRENCY, RI.STANDARDEXRATE, 
RI.NEGOTIATEDEXRATE, ALLOCATEDAMOUNT, TOTALALLOCATEDAMOUNT, TRANSACTIONREFNO, CBECLASSIFICATION, SHIPMENTMETHOD,
SHIPMENTDATE, REVERSALREASON, CLOSUREREASON, IMPORTERNAME, IMPORTERCOUNTRY, IMPORTERADDRESS, IMPORTERPHONENO,
IMPORTERBANK, BICCODE, IBANACCOUNT, BANKCOUNTRY, BANKADDRESS, BANKPHONENO, COLLECTINGBANKREF, CURRENTSTEPNAME, 
RI.BPMINSTANCENUMBER, 

INV.INVOICENO, INV.INVOICEDATE, 

B.BILLOFLADINGREF , B.BILLOFLADINGDATE, 

FCT.ACCOUNTNO,FCT.POSTINGDATE, FCT.VALUEDATE, FCT.TRANSACTIONAMOUNT, FCT.TRANSACTIONAMOUNT, FCT.AMOUNTINBPM,

PI.PARTYID,PI.PARTYTYPE,PI.CIF,

CC.COMPONENT, CC.DEFAULTCURRENCY, CC.DEFAULTAMOUNT, CC.CHARGEAMOUNT, --CC.WAIVER ,
CC.ACCOUNTCLASS, CC.ACCOUNTNO, CC.BRANCHCODE, CC.CURRENCY, CC.BALANCE, CC.BALANCESIGN, CC.STANDARDEXRATE,
CC.NEGOTIATEDEXRATE, CC.DEBITEDAMOUNT,

MTD.INSTALLMENTDATE, MTD.INSTALLMENTAMOUNT

FROM ODC_REQUESTINFO RI
INNER JOIN ODC_INVOICE INV   		 ON  RI.ID = INV.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_BILLS B       	 	 ON  RI.ID = B.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_FCTRANSACTION FCT   	 ON  RI.ID = FCT.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_PARTIESINFO PI  		 ON  RI.ID = PI.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_CHARGESCOMMISSIONS CC ON  RI.ID = CC.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_MULTITENORDATES MTD   ON  RI.ID = MTD.REQUESRID

WHERE RI.REQUESTNO = '<#= tw.local.requestNumber #>'

RI.USERREF, RI.PRODUCTCODE, PRODUCTDESC, STAGE, SOURCEREF, TRADEFOREFNO, DISCOUNT, EXTRACHARGES, OURCHARGES,
AMOUNTSIGHT, AMOUNTDEFNOAVALIZATION, AMOUNTDEFAVALIZATION, COLLECTABLEAMOUNT, OUTSTANDINGAMOUNT, MATURITYDATE,
MATURITYDAYS, FINANCEAPPROVALNO, HUBCODE, HUBNAME, LIQAMOUNT, LIQCURRENCY, COLLECTIONCURRENCY, RI.STANDARDEXRATE, 
RI.NEGOTIATEDEXRATE, ALLOCATEDAMOUNT, TOTALALLOCATEDAMOUNT, TRANSACTIONREFNO, CBECLASSIFICATION, SHIPMENTMETHOD,
SHIPMENTDATE, REVERSALREASON, CLOSUREREASON, IMPORTERNAME, IMPORTERCOUNTRY, IMPORTERADDRESS, IMPORTERPHONENO,
IMPORTERBANK, BICCODE, IBANACCOUNT, BANKCOUNTRY, BANKADDRESS, BANKPHONENO, COLLECTINGBANKREF, CURRENTSTEPNAME, 
RI.BPMINSTANCENUMBER, 

INV.INVOICENO, INV.INVOICEDATE, 

B.BILLOFLADINGREF , B.BILLOFLADINGDATE, 

FCT.ACCOUNTNO,FCT.POSTINGDATE, FCT.VALUEDATE, FCT.TRANSACTIONAMOUNT, FCT.TRANSACTIONAMOUNT, FCT.AMOUNTINBPM,

PI.PARTYID,PI.PARTYTYPE,PI.CIF,

CC.COMPONENT, CC.DEFAULTCURRENCY, CC.DEFAULTAMOUNT, CC.CHARGEAMOUNT, --CC.WAIVER ,
CC.ACCOUNTCLASS, CC.ACCOUNTNO, CC.BRANCHCODE, CC.CURRENCY, CC.BALANCE, CC.BALANCESIGN, CC.STANDARDEXRATE,
CC.NEGOTIATEDEXRATE, CC.DEBITEDAMOUNT,

MTD.INSTALLMENTDATE, MTD.INSTALLMENTAMOUNT

FROM ODC_REQUESTINFO RI
INNER JOIN ODC_INVOICE INV   		 ON  RI.ID = INV.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_BILLS B       	 	 ON  RI.ID = B.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_FCTRANSACTION FCT   	 ON  RI.ID = FCT.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_PARTIESINFO PI  		 ON  RI.ID = PI.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_CHARGESCOMMISSIONS CC ON  RI.ID = CC.REQUESRID
INNER JOIN ODC_MULTITENORDATES MTD   ON  RI.ID = MTD.REQUESRID

WHERE RI.REQUESTNO = '<#= tw.local.requestNumber #>'
